<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the compound shows a para‑disubstituted benzene ring (four aromatic protons appearing as two equivalent sets) and an –CH₂‑CH₂‑ fragment where each CH₂ is a triplet (J ≈ 7 Hz), typical of a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ group flanked by the aromatic ring on one side and a carbonyl on the other. This pattern matches 4‑ethyl‑acetophenone. The SMILES for this molecule is "CC(=O)CC1=CC=C(C)C=C1".</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)CC1=CC=C(C)C=C1</final_answer>
